main_turf.surface: Turf (one of the fastest-draining surfaces on the NSW North Coast)
main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). A premier championship-standard 1,940m oval with approximately 25m track width, a beautifully cambered home bend, and a spacious 400m home straight. At nearly 2,000m in circumference with a wide, sweeping layout, Grafton is one of the most equitable racing surfaces in regional NSW. The fast-draining base (predominantly sandy loam) means the track rarely deteriorates past Soft 7 even during sustained Northern Rivers rainfall. The wide bends and long straight give off-pace swooping types ('S') and pressers ('P') a genuine run-home opportunity — this is NOT a pure front-runner's track.
main_turf.post_bias: LARGELY BIAS-FREE ON OPEN GROUND: The 25m width and 400m straight neutralize most barrier advantages at route distances (1400m+). Inside barriers (1-4) retain a mild edge in 1000m and 1200m sprints. At 1600m and beyond, draws are largely irrelevant — race tempo and class form dominate.

handicapping_angles.grafton_july_carnival_listed_class: The Grafton July Racing Carnival is one of Australia's premier country racing events. Key races: Listed Grafton Cup (2350m, ~$150k+) and Listed Ramornie Handicap (1200m, ~$160k+). Apply full Tier 1 class analysis for these two races — they attract elite Sydney Metro (Waller, Waterhouse/Bott, Maher) and QLD stables. Upgrade provincial-class form significantly.
handicapping_angles.ramornie_handicap_sprint_specialist: The Ramornie Handicap (1200m Listed) is a highly competitive sprint attracting Tier 1 sprinting talent. Upgrade horses with sub-70 second 1200m speed figures from Randwick or Flemington. The fast-draining surface rewards straight-forward sprint types who can sustain sectionals.
handicapping_angles.grafton_cup_staying_angle: The Grafton Cup (2350m Listed) is a critical staying test. Upgrade genuine stayers with 2000m+ metro form (Randwick, Flemington, Sandown). Beware of milers masquerading as stayers — the 1940m oval at full trip is a thorough stamina test.
handicapping_angles.northern_rivers_local_form_cross: Grafton draws from the Northern Rivers region (Lismore, Casino, Murwillumbah, Coffs Harbour). At non-Carnival meetings, local trainer knowledge (Fred Kersley, Dean Mirfin, Mick Rollinson) provides strong edges over travelled metro horses. Upgrade in-form locals at BM58-BM70 level.
handicapping_angles.fast_draining_wet_track_caution: Despite northern coastal location, Grafton's fast-draining sandy loam base means Heavy ratings are short-lived. Do NOT overrate wet-track specialists — the track often recovers quickly between the morning and afternoon. Always check morning vs afternoon track rating for late-shifting meetings.
handicapping_angles.typical_distances: Regular program: 1000m, 1200m, 1400m, 1600m, 1800m, 2000m, 2350m. July Carnival extends to full stayer distances.

par_adjustment.tier: Tier 2.5 (NSW Premier Country / Carnival Listed Venue)
